entries.basis: Three separate firsthand Alo Trail wear impressions: Olivia Halevy/Toms Guide (Apr14), Tim Kohut/Mens Health (Apr12), Nikki Chwatt/Who What Wear (Apr9), 2026. Short-term walking, office/gym and city-wear comments; not rigorous long-distance trail-running tests. Kohut expressly had not run in them, Halevy disclaims outdoor expertise. Toms Guide and Who What Wear share Future ownership; Mens Health is Hearst. Three critics, two ownership groups, not three independent owners. Affiliate commerce disclosures retained; sample provision not independently established.
